instruction: A single snow leopard captured mid-prowl, shoulder blades raised and one forepaw lifted, with an enormously thick tail curving back and up nearly the length of its body. Dense smoke-grey fur is stippled with black rosettes that fade to pure cream on the belly and inner legs, and individual guard hairs catch the light along the spine. Pale jade eyes, a soft pink nose, and long white whiskers finish the head.
